observation.how_to_check: gh api 'repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?status=queued&per_page=100' older than 24h; for each, actions/runs/<id>/jobs total_count
observation.what: ghost queued runs (0 jobs) older than 24h: 36 of 38 listed at 2026-10-28T20:05Z, 21 from 2026-05-15 (issue-triggered vm-*/trainer/health workflows), 11 from 2026-09-12, 3 later; operator decides whether to cancel

what: [stuck-runs] Old queued runs have no jobs (sampled 3 of 36: 0 jobs each), so they hold no runner and cannot be served by any label; the dispatcher already ignores them (>24 h filter). Likely orphaned at run creation (GitHub side), not a runner-label or concurrency deadlock. Harmless to dispatch; cancel only to tidy. They are not the cause of the repo-queued deferral: the 17 counted were fresh runs (12 claude-run-failure-alert listeners excluded, PR checks).
